Nepal is witnessing its biggest GenZ protest as thousands of students aged 13–20 hit the streets of Kathmandu against social media ban and corruption. A movement that started online has now toppled the government, forced the Prime Minister to flee, and left the country leaderless. From unemployment and inequality to political corruption, this youth uprising is rewriting Nepal’s future. With India and China’s influence in the background, the protest shows how young voices can shake entire nations.
